description: Lists the Admin API scopes apart from the others, counts first and member data after
replace:
$1 if="$scope.addon_id != 'Hampel/AdminApi'">$2</xf:foreach>
						<xf:optgroup label="{{ phrase('hampel_adminapi_scopes_heading') }}">
							$1 if="$scope.addon_id == 'Hampel/AdminApi' && !in_array($scope.api_scope_id, ['hampel_admin_api:error_detail', 'hampel_admin_api:ips', 'hampel_admin_api:upgrade_records', 'hampel_admin_api:staff', 'hampel_admin_api:log_entries'])">$2</xf:foreach>
						</xf:optgroup>
						<xf:optgroup label="{{ phrase('hampel_adminapi_scopes_heading_member') }}">
							$1 if="$scope.addon_id == 'Hampel/AdminApi' && in_array($scope.api_scope_id, ['hampel_admin_api:error_detail', 'hampel_admin_api:ips', 'hampel_admin_api:upgrade_records', 'hampel_admin_api:staff', 'hampel_admin_api:log_entries'])">$2</xf:foreach>
						</xf:optgroup>
